title: Keto Sausage Balls
description: These keto sausage balls filled with cream cheese, Parmesan, and Cheddar are the perfect Game Day snack!
ingredients: 0.5 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, at room temperature

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Combine sausage, cream cheese, Cheddar cheese, Parmesan cheese, mustard, garlic powder, and salt in a large bowl. Mix gently until just combined. Roll heaping tablespoonfuls of the pork mixture into balls. Place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes. Place on a paper towel-lined plate to soak up excess grease. Serve immediately.

video.description: Looking for easy, high-protein snacks to power your day? In this video, Nicole shares 10 delicious, protein-packed snack recipes that are perfect for meal prep, mid-day cravings, or post-workout fuel. From a savory Air Fryer Tortilla Pizza to crave-worthy High-Protein Chocolate Chip Cookies, these snacks are quick, satisfying, and loaded with flavor. Nicole also whips up a creamy Buffalo Chicken Dip, sweet and simple 2-Ingredient Protein Cheesecake, and crispy Cottage Cheese Chips—all designed to keep you full and energized. Whether you're snacking smarter, adding more protein to your diet, or just looking for fun new recipes, these high-protein bites are sure to earn a spot in your weekly routine.
